preservedMissingEntityPolicyAudit.counterexample: After initial projection, explicitly remove a snow entity through Scene.remove, then pass the same tile object again. Both frozen and adopted projection retain the tile record, see entities.has(id) false and leave the entity absent.
preservedMissingEntityPolicyAudit.test: The permanent full-class oracle asserts that this preexisting behavior is unchanged; a replacement tile object still follows the original remove/add path.
preservedMissingEntityPolicyAudit.productionPathAudit: Source references to the snow-volume ID namespace are confined to the projection's replacement/pruning/dispose paths, called by TheGameEngineRenderer. Those paths manage the tile record too; disposal clears it. No actual canonical/native occurrence of an independent removal was established.
preservedMissingEntityPolicyAudit.conclusion: Potential external-mutation consistency policy, not a newly proven live visual defect. It was not silently changed as part of this performance patch.
